 Via Mississippi State, 22h ago STARKVILLE – The Bulldogs lose a hard-fought match to the No. 4 Florida Gators . State never let up against the Gators in front of a top 20 crowd in The Griss. They fell in the first two sets 25-21 and 25-19 before coming back in Set 3. After being down 18-14 the Bulldogs came back with force. After a 4-0 scoring run the Bulldogs kept the lead and won the set, 25-21. Gha'Naye Whitfield-Moss led the team with a career high tying 15 kills earning the team 19 points.
